repos.description: Documentation sources rendered by this Vellum deployment.

nav.description: Site-level top navigation. Each repo can also declare its own nav (vellum.json `nav` or VitePress themeConfig.nav) which takes precedence inside that repo.

title.description: Brand name shown in the NavBar and as the page <title> suffix.

url.description: Public origin of the site, e.g. "https://docs.example.com". Used for absolute canonical / Open Graph / hreflang URLs, the sitemap and the files for AI agents (/.well-known/ and the Link headers on /); without it those URLs stay root-relative and neither the sitemap nor the agent files are written.

tagline.description: Short subtitle shown on the landing page hero.

logo.description: URL of the site logo (SVG recommended).

themeColor.description: Accent colour (primary buttons, links, focus) and the <meta name="theme-color"> value, e.g. "#0078d4".

footer.description: Footer text rendered below every page.

homepageRepo.description: Slug of the repo whose root acts as the site's landing page, served at /{locale prefix}. The NavBar brand link points here with the current locale preserved.

defaultLocale.description: Locale code used when the URL has no locale prefix.

locales.description: All supported locales. Order is preserved in the language picker.

socialLinks.description: Icon-only links rendered in the NavBar between the locale picker and theme toggle. Built-in icons cover github / gitlab / x / discord / slack / mastodon / bluesky / youtube / linkedin / instagram / facebook / npm / rss / stackoverflow / reddit / twitch / telegram; custom glyphs go via `{ svg: "<svg ...>" }`.

searchAliases.description: Search synonyms. Each key is a term a reader might type; the value is the list of words the docs author probably used for the same concept. A reader searching for any of these terms also matches pages containing the others (alias hits score below primary hits). Merged on top of a built-in baseline (latex/math, auth/oauth, ws/websocket, …) so config only needs to spell out product-specific vocabulary.

contentSignal.description: How AI may use the site's content, written to robots.txt as a Content-Signal line (https://contentsignals.org), e.g. { "search": true, "ai-input": true, "ai-train": false } → "Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no". Signals left out state no preference.

code.description: Locale code (e.g. "en", "zh", "ja"). Used for i18n lookup and as the default source directory of non-default locales.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in the language picker.

prefix.description: URL segment for this locale (e.g. "zh" → /repo/zh/...). Empty string means the locale lives at the root of each repo.

search.description: Building a search index and linking to the content in results.

ai-input.description: Feeding the content to an AI model to answer a question (retrieval-augmented generation, grounding).

slug.description: URL segment for the repo (e.g. "prism" → /prism/...). Must be unique within `repos[]`.

source.description: Where the markdown lives. "github" (default) clones the GitHub repo at build time; "local" reads from local-docs/{slug}/ in this repository.

owner.description: GitHub owner. Required when source is "github".

repo.description: GitHub repo name. Required when source is "github".

branch.description: Branch the build clones. Used when no `versions[]` is declared.

docsRoot.description: Path inside the repo (or local source) to the docs tree, e.g. "docs". Empty string means the repo root is the docs root.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the NavBar brand crumb and 404 suggestions.

description.description: Description of the repo's index page when its frontmatter sets none.

logo.description: URL of the per-repo logo (SVG recommended).

editLinkPattern.description: Template for the "Edit this page" link in the page footer. `:path` is substituted with the docs-root-relative path. Omit for local repos.

versions.description: Optional versions. The build renders the default one (or the first).

localeDirs.description: Source directory of each locale's pages, relative to docsRoot, keyed by locale code (e.g. { "en": "en", "zh": "zh" }). Locales left out keep the default layout: the default locale at the docs root, others in a directory named after their code.

landingPage.description: Path the repo's root URL redirects to, relative to the repo (e.g. "v0.4" sends /{locale}/{slug} to /{locale}/{slug}/v0.4). Use it when the docs root holds no real home page, such as docs versioned by directory.

localPath.description: Override for where local-source files live. Defaults to `local-docs/{slug}`. Path is relative to the project root.

hideInBrand.description: When true, the NavBar omits this repo's displayName crumb after the site title. Useful for the homepageRepo so the brand doesn't read "Site | Site".

excludeFromSearch.description: When true, the repo is omitted from search results in both the per-repo dialog scope picker and the cross-repo full-page search. Use for landing-page repos and other "system" content the reader shouldn't be sent to by a query.

socialLinks.description: Per-repo override for site.socialLinks. Shown in the NavBar while the reader is inside this repo. The repo's own vellum.json#socialLinks or VitePress themeConfig.socialLinks take higher priority when present.

searchAliases.description: Per-repo search synonyms. Layered on top of the site-level alias map (and the built-in baseline) when searching within this repo. Use for vocabulary that only makes sense for this product — e.g. mapping a code-name to its public-facing term.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the version picker (e.g. "v2", "main", "next").

branch.description: Git branch / ref this version corresponds to.

default.description: True for the version selected when no explicit version is encoded in the URL.

link.description: Destination URL or site-relative path. Omit when this item is a dropdown trigger (use `items`).

items.description: Children — turns this nav entry into a dropdown menu.

activeMatch.description: Regex against the path of the current page in the docs, locale directory included (e.g. "/zh/guide/intro"), as in VitePress. Lets a nav entry stay highlighted across a whole section.

title: Vellum site config
description: Top-level config consumed by the Vellum build. Generated from src/shared/types.ts by scripts/gen-site-schema.ts — edit the types or that script's OVERRIDES table, not this file.
